title: Cross-disease case-control transcriptome resource: analysis code and data deposit (release v1.2)
description:
Analysis code and the eleven-folder data deposit of a cross-disease case-control transcriptome resource: 26 public case-control accessions across 10 disease contexts (25 of them in the estimates layer, after patient-level de-duplication of one pancreatic accession), 17 frozen signalling modules (99 genes) and 425 cohort-module pairs, scored in three separate layers (bulk GSVA z-scores, TCGA member-mean z-scores, single-cell member means) with coverage-aware standardised effect sizes (SMDH, SMCRPH), REML pooling with Hartung-Knapp inference, and a validation ledger that separates PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL and NOT TESTED.

Contents: deposit/ (data, quality-control records, reuse examples, environment and the archived pipeline), the maintained Python and R implementations under src/, R/, scripts/ and tests/, printed reference tables under data/reference/, and the integrity manifests deposit/08_qc/file_inventory_and_checksums.csv and deposit/08_qc/checksums_sha256.txt.

Release v1.2 (deposit v20.0, 2026-11-10) is a documentation-completeness release: the field dictionary deposit/08_qc/data_dictionary.csv now documents every shipped table (99 of 99 CSV files, 844 field definitions), deposit/07_estimates/PROVENANCE.md states both the delivered (442) and the estimates-layer (425) row counts, and deposit/08_qc/qc_common_gene_sensitivity.csv defines its n_common column. No estimate, count or statistic changes with respect to v1.1.

Release v1.1 (deposit v19.0, 2026-11-10) adds the patient-level de-duplication of the pancreatic accessions: GSE62452 and GSE28735 are the same 42 patients (profile r median 0.996), GSE62452 is held out of every pooled estimate, and all tables derived from the estimates layer are re-estimated (418 estimable pairs; 82 states with two cohorts and 83 with three; 57 of 83 fully concordant).
